Distribution. This subspecies is recorded from a number of localities in the coastal belt bordering the Western and Eastern Cape provinces. WC, Knysna Forest: Witte Fontein, dry sandy soil; Deep Walls Research Hill, nursery beds; Buffel's Nek veld with low bush ploughed for plantations. Knysna area: Belvedere, bank of pond near beach; Knysna, Veldschoen’s Drift, wooded ‘ kloof’. Knysna-Avontuur road, various sites and biotopes. George area: The Wilderness (specimens collected from the wood sloping down to estuary). Riversdale Mts at ca. 150 - 450 m asl. Garcias Pass, near Riversdale, black sandy soil near stream. Avontuur, Uniondale area, mountains north of Heidelberg. Langeberg Mts: Duivel's Bosch, various sites at the bank of stream; Kolonies Bosch, by the stream above the woods. Pass between Calitzdorp and Ladismith. Buffelsjagts river near Zuurbraak in Swellendam area, loamy soil deposited by floods. Swellendam Mts at ca. 900 – 1500 m asl. EC, Humansdorp vicinity, Witte Els Bosch (recently burnt ground); Storms River in the litter.
Distribution range of species. Badakhshan and western part of the Hindukush Mountains within Afghanistan (new record) and Tajikistan.
New Guinea (W-Irian Jaya: Mt. Antares, Mt. Wilhelmina, W-Papua New Guinea: Mt. Kerewa, Star Mts.)
